_doc: TANG 2 — vi du nganh giay chay cho LLM#2.
huongDan: Vi du: khach 'boston 13 den' + ung vien 'ADIZERO BOSTON 13 M den' → chon; khach 'adios' + ung vien 'ADIZERO ADIOS PRO 4' → KHONG (Adios va Adios Pro la hai dong).
Chu M / W cuoi ten la nam / nu; khach khong noi gioi tinh thi khong dung no de loai.
